entities.summary: Gerar was an ancient city and district in the southern Levant, located in what is today south-central Israel. It is mentioned in the Book of Genesis and later biblical texts, including the Second Book of Chronicles. In the patriarchal narratives, Gerar is depicted as being ruled by non-Israelite elites; its later association with Philistines reflects a subsequent historical period.
